description: Removed the Turns 9–10 chicane and widened several corners.
Endurance configuration with a long infield loop, 2010 GP only. From 2012 the standard layout (bahrain_v1) was used again.
Outer circuit, 2020 Sakhir GP (round 16) only. Round 15 and later Bahrain GPs used the standard layout (bahrain_v1).
Inserted a slow chicane before the final corner.
Replaced the tight Turn 10 hairpin with a wider-radius bend.
Bypassed the final chicane while retaining the revised Turn 10.
First F1 return since 2006 used the straight past the pits after removal of Variante Bassa.
Tightened the Turns 22–23 sequence to reduce approach speed. Whole-lap effect is less certain.
Replaced the Singapore Sling triple chicane at Turn 10 with a single left turn.
Realigned Turns 10–13 and switched sides on Anderson Bridge. Whole-lap effect is less certain.
Replaced Turns 16–19 around the Bay Grandstand with a straight.
Reprofiled several corners including adverse camber at the final hairpin. Whole-lap effect is less certain.
Arena infield section replaced the old route via Bridge and Priory.
Removed the chicane before the hairpin and replaced the marina sequence with a banked left turn.
